loginDescription: Your data. Your SQL. A clearer picture.
passwordHint: Use the administrator password printed in your terminal on first launch.
name: Name
welcomeDescription: Build a pipeline, follow every transformation, and understand the story behind each value.
exampleDescription: Explore Northstar: a complete revenue pipeline with joins, reusable components, exports and cell lineage.
dragHint: Drag a node onto the canvas
occupied: This worktree has an active run. Wait or stop it before starting another.
selectionHint: Shift-click nodes to select a group
selectNode: Select a node to configure it, inspect its SQL and explore its results.
noResultHint: Run this node and its ancestors to materialize a preview.
snapshotHint: Materialized at execution time. Refresh source data with a manual run.
staleHint: This is the last successful result. Recompute to explore lineage.
lineageHint: Select any value in a valid preview to trace it to its sources.
lineageInterrupted: This exploration was interrupted by recalculation or an edit. Select a cell in a new valid result.
compileHint: Compiling does not run the pipeline.
sharedTemplateHint: Changes affect every instance of this local definition in the current branch.
sharedComponentHint: You are editing a shared component definition in this branch.
confirmDelete: Remove this node and its connections?
catalogHint: Shared by all projects. Settings and secrets stay outside project Git history.
secretHint: Stored outside Git. Leave the masked value to keep the existing secret.
localPreferences: Theme and language are saved on this browser independently of your projects.
author: Author
metadataOnly: Historical records contain metadata only. Restarting clears in-memory previews and lineage.
restoreRevision: Open revision in a new branch
mergeHint: Resolve any conflicts in the combined files. The graph and interfaces must validate before merging.
conflictHint: Both proposals are preserved. Choose a version or edit a combined result.
invalidHint: Invalid content is saved and versioned. Correct the files to enable execution.
fileHint: UI and file edits share the same source of truth. Every save is automatically committed, including invalid content.
documentationPlaceholder: Describe the meaning, source, rules and assumptions…
importHint: Copies definitions and nested dependencies. Future changes in the source project do not affect your copy.
noNodesHint: Add a source from the palette, then connect transformations.
emptyDocumentation: Add context that travels with your pipeline.
aboutText: Duckpad is a local SQL workspace powered by DuckDB, React Flow and Python. All computation is manual; your project files are automatically versioned.
exposedHint: JSON map of parameter names to type, default and internal targets. See the example components.
cancelRunHint: Cancellation waits for active SQL and cleanup. Completed external writes are not undone.
schemaHint: Connect and run the input nodes to see their columns.
advancedExpressionHint: The generated SQL expressions below remain editable. Save parameters when ready.
compactLineageHint: This panel explains one step. Explore lineage to investigate all roles and upstream boundaries.
chooseContribution: Select a contribution role to inspect its records.
reason_value: These cells supply the selected expression. Participation counts preserve repeated uses; values are not summed across roles.
reason_condition: These records explain selection, matching, or evaluation context. They are not additive terms.
reason_existence: These input rows establish that the result row exists, even when their values are not used in this column.
lineageBudgetHint: Lazy exploration · 10 s per request · at most 100 records per page
lineageBudgetTimeout: This request exceeded its 10 second budget. Retry or inspect a smaller upstream step.
lineageStageBudget: The 64-step investigation budget is reached. Return to an existing step or select a new target from the preview.
investigationCancelled: Investigation paused. The preview and visited steps are retained.
graphKeyboardHint: Tab to select · Alt + ←/→ to navigate steps
lineageKind_source: Retained source cell from this execution.
lineageKind_projection: Calculated from the selected input row.
lineageKind_join: Value from the captured join pair. Inspect each input role separately.
lineageKind_filter: Value retained after the selection condition.
lineageKind_aggregate: Aggregate over the participating input rows.
lineageKind_distinct: Distinct output with all original occurrences retained.
lineageKind_window: Window calculation over the captured partition and frame.
lineageKind_union: Distinct union of the two input roles.
lineageKind_intersect: Value present in both input roles.
lineageKind_except: Left value retained after comparison with the right input.
joinPairsHint: Stable row IDs for each input role. Select a role to inspect its complete records.
joinPairsBounded: First 25 pairs shown. Role totals and paginated records cover every participating row.
